papers_found.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
papers_found.summary: Regime-conditional signal activation: activate value + short-term reversal only during stock-specific drift regimes (>60% positive days in trailing 63-day window). Claims OOS Sharpe > 13 after costs. Validated vs random regime filters, execution slippage, 2008 liquidity crisis.
papers_found.actionability: Direct extension of H181 (industry reversal) and H241 (cross-sectional momentum) — add regime gate condition

papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.summary: BERT-LDA joint embedding + HDBSCAN clustering on 138,000 earnings press releases (2005-2023). Topic structure predicts announcement-day returns better than standalone BERT. Combines contextual semantics (BERT) with thematic narrative (LDA).
papers_found.actionability: Upgrade PEAD scoring from FinBERT-only to BERT-LDA topic-enhanced composite score

papers_found.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Modeling, Measuring, and Trading on Alpha Decay
papers_found.summary: Derives hyperbolic decay α(t) = K/(1+λt) from game-theoretic equilibrium. Momentum crowding benign; reversal crowding dangerous. Momentum R²=0.65 for hyperbolic fit vs 0.51 linear, 0.61 exponential. Factor-specific decay rates support different IS window sizing.
papers_found.reason_not_staged: Informative for IS window calibration but not a new testable hypothesis — incorporated into signal-halflife.md mental model

papers_found.title: Regime-Adaptive Continual Learning for Portfolio Management
papers_found.summary: Continual RL framework for portfolio management that adapts to regime changes without catastrophic forgetting. Addresses GFC-calibrated model staleness — directly relevant to H251 degenerate-regime problem (HMM never transitioning 2018-2025).
papers_found.reason_not_staged: Relevant to H251b but implementation complexity is high; needs H251b basic rolling-retrain test first before RL-continual approach

papers_found.title: Tactical Asset Allocation with Macroeconomic Regime Detection
papers_found.summary: Novel regime classifier forecasts distribution of future regimes and integrates with Black-Litterman for tactical allocation. Outperforms equal-weight, buy-and-hold, random regime baselines.
papers_found.reason_not_staged: Partially covered by H249/H250/H251 work. H249 discrete bins already confirmed. Black-Litterman integration too complex vs direct weight mapping.

papers_found.title: AlphaAgents: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents for Equity Portfolio Constructions
papers_found.summary: Role-based multi-agent LLM framework for equity portfolio: fundamental, sentiment, and valuation agents collaborate for stock selection. Systematic equity portfolio construction.
papers_found.reason_not_staged: TradingAgents (arXiv:2412.20138) already in wiki (ml-for-trading.md). AlphaAgents is similar; marginal novelty vs what's already documented.
